newsitem.title: FRANCE: CYCLING-ULLRICH FIRST GERMAN TO WIN TOUR DE FRANCE.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-ULLRICH FIRST GERMAN TO WIN TOUR DE FRANCE.

text.p: Jan Ullrich became the first German to win the Tour de France on Sunday.
Ullrich, who was second in 1996 and won two stages this year, completed the 22-day classic in just over 100 hours to become at 23 years eight months the fourth youngest winner since 1947.
He finished nine minutes nine seconds in front of Richard Virenque of France, the biggest winning margin since 1984.
Virenque was second and crowned king of the mountains for the fourth Tour in succession.
Italian Marco Pantani, who won two stages in three days in the Alps, was third for the second time in three years.
Erik Zabel of Germany took the points winner's green jersey for the second consecutive year.
Nicola Minali of Italy won the last stage over 149.5 kms from Disneyland in a sprint finish on the Champs Elysees. Minali also won the fourth stage.
